Voter Guide

Jessica Arriaga (Example Party)

Occupation / Current Position: Member of Congress

What are your top priorities if elected?

I will introduce legislation to cap insulin co-pays at $35 per month for every insured patient. I will also vote to extend the rural broadband construction credit through 2030.

How would you address the cost of housing?

I will sponsor a bill to fund 60,000 new affordable housing units in the first two years.
